25: # Video Frames (ffmpeg)

46: - Use a `.jpg` for quick share; use `.png` for crisp UI frames.", "scripts/frame.sh": "1: #!/usr/bin/env bash

62:   ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -y \
